$comment: CIRPASS-2 artefact manifest. Phase 0 task 0.2 of docs/plans/CIRPASS_2_MIGRATION.md. Each row is one downloadable artefact from the DPP Vocabulary Hub. Operators MUST replace every TODO_* GUID with the real OntologyVersion_<uuid> / JsonSchemaVersion_<uuid> from https://dpp.vocabulary-hub.eu/specifications before invoking fetch_cirpass.py --fetch. See tools/snapshot/README.md for how to pair titles to GUIDs from the hub UI.

artefacts.title: EUDPP CORE ontology Product and DPP module
artefacts.notes: Core product/DPP axioms. Imported by CORE.

artefacts.title: EUDPP CORE ontology Substance of Concerns module
artefacts.notes: Substances of Concern (REACH/SVHC). Imported by CORE.

artefacts.title: EUDPP Core Ontology Life Cycle Assessment module
artefacts.notes: PEF 3.1 impact categories. Newer than its sibling modules; the 'Maki' suffix is part of the upstream version string.

artefacts.title: EUDPP Core Ontology ACTOR module
artefacts.notes: Actor / role hierarchy per ESPR Art 2(37-55). Imported by CORE.

artefacts.title: EUDPP CORE ontology CONNECTOR module
artefacts.notes: Cross-module relations bridge. New module with no predecessor in the current bundle.

artefacts.title: EUDPP Core Ontology (CORE umbrella)
artefacts.notes: Umbrella that owl:imports the other modules. Vendor last so import chain resolves.

artefacts.title: CIRPASS DPP reference structure
artefacts.notes: Hierarchical message model. The hub does NOT publish a JSON Schema for this (per D-0.1) — the tree-view export is the source of truth, and Phase 3 derives the JSON Schema via tools/codegen/cirpass/derive_schema.py. Operator must paste the tree-view export URL into ``source_url`` (the message endpoint pattern is not the same as ontology/json-schema).

artefacts.title: MVP Textile DPP
artefacts.notes: CIRPASS-2 Textile group. Drives the plugins/textiles/ refresh in Phase 7.

artefacts.title: GDSO Ambassador Data Models
artefacts.notes: Suite spec for the four tyre declarations. License: see OA-1 (default GPL-3.0).

artefacts.title: Tyre Lifecycle History
artefacts.notes: Wraps the four declarations (Birth → Collection → Retread → Recycling).

artefacts.title: Birth Declaration
artefacts.notes: Tyre 'digital birth certificate'. Pre-1.0 — versioning unstable.
